text: {"assertions":["A latency spike in ml/serving/batcher.py was caused by an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The latency issue affected only clients using the v1 SDK.","The issue can be reproduced by sending mixed-size request traces.","The fix prefetched the relation in a single query via PR #2697 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The latency fix reduced job execution time from 3 hours to 45 minutes.","Test coverage for the batcher fix exists in tests/ml/test_batcher.py."]}
